surface_verification.justification: CLI/library-only change: ci_execution_evidence.py + promote_required_layers.py + ci_execution_evidence_check.py add a gh-API-backed execution-tier evidence resolver, a per-FR promotion CLI, and a read-only diagnostic CLI -- no web UI, API server, or SSE/WS surface to drive. The surface run above is the CLI-facing pytest suite for the new/changed shared/tests + shared/scripts/tools/tests modules for this mechanism (test_ci_execution_evidence.py, test_layer_promotion_ledger.py, test_layer_promotion.py, test_layer_promotion_apply.py, test_fr_layer_cell_writer.py, test_ci_yml_execution_evidence_step_shape.py, test_promote_required_layers.py, test_ci_execution_evidence_check.py, test_record_layer_promotion_decision.py); the canonical F0 run (all 18 monorepo test roots, this run-id, GREEN) is the broader unit/integration evidence.

behaviors.behavior: AC-R1: resolve_execution_evidence returns confirmed with a per-FR map only when verification is verified AND the artifact is listed/unexpired/downloads/parses AND passes both content-binding checks; unavailable and error are each their own distinct closed set of causes
AC-R2 (the forgery test): hand-edited committed coverage with no CI confirmation available never promotes
AC-R3: confirmed evidence not containing the FR being evaluated is a decided skip, never a crash or escalation
AC-R4: a demoted-ledger FR stays a clean skip when CI evidence is unavailable, both on unchanged and worse-drifted evidence, never spuriously escalates

AC-R6: main() never reads the working-tree manifest file for evaluation by default (commit-pinned single read); --manifest forces dry-run and never writes the ledger or spec.md regardless of computed decisions

AC-R8: the new ci.yml artifact-upload step's if:/continue-on-error/retention-days/if-no-files-found are pinned exactly, positioned immediately after the drift-check step, and the python-checks job carries no strategy.matrix key today

AC-R10 (content binding): an artifact whose source_commit mismatches the resolved commit, or whose structural shape disagrees with the committed manifest, resolves error and never falls through to confirmed
AC-R11: a poisoned acs field on an FR node never changes evaluate_fr's decision, ledger fingerprint, or spec.md write versus the same node with acs removed

AC-R13 (realistic-shape escalation): a bound test recorded as enabled/not_run (not empty, not failing) for a required layer escalates via REASON_BOUND_TEST_ABSENT, matching the spec's named case exactly

AC-R14 (fingerprint-noise regression pin): two CI-sourced evidence snapshots for the same demoted FR that differ in raw content but agree predicate_holds stays False both stay a clean skip, neither re-escalates

AC-R15: evidence.status==error is an operational failure -- exit 2 with an {error:...} JSON body, plan_promotions never called, no ledger/spec.md write of any kind, distinct from the 0/3 decided-outcome exits

AC-R16: the standalone diagnostic CLI (ci_execution_evidence_check.py) always exits 0 regardless of resolved status, including an unresolvable --commit, and never touches spec.md or the ledger under any input
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_ci_execution_evidence_check.py (11 tests, incl. a real subprocess invocation) ALL PASSED

behaviors.behavior: round-3 external-review fix: the selected newest-by-created_at artifact's own numeric id is what actually reaches the download call -- not silently re-resolved by name to a different attempt

round-3 external-review fix: a structurally-matching artifact with a deleted (not merely falsy) coverage/tests key on the RAW node is rejected as error before normalization, never silently resolved confirmed with empty requirements

round-3 external-review fix: promote_required_layers.py's --manifest dry-run branch wraps load_ledger/plan_promotions in the same error shape as the real-write path -- a corrupted ledger or an escaping spec_path is a clean {error:...} exit 2, never a raw traceback

round-4 post-push code-reviewer fix (HIGH): plan_promotions looks up CI-confirmed evidence by the committed manifest's own NAMESPACED key (NN::FR-XX.YY), not a node's bare id -- CI evidence that genuinely disagrees with a stale/rosy committed claim, in EITHER direction (CI greener than committed, and CI weaker than committed), is what actually drives the promotion decision
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_promote_required_layers.py::test_ci_confirmed_evidence_overrides_a_greener_committed_claim, ::test_ci_confirmed_evidence_overrides_a_committed_claim_that_was_too_optimistic PASSED -- both independently verified RED against the pre-fix bare-id lookup before being confirmed GREEN against the fix

behaviors.behavior: round-4 post-push code-reviewer fix (HIGH), end-to-end composition: the REAL resolve_execution_evidence (mocking only ITS OWN gh/GitHub dependencies) composed with the REAL plan_promotions produces an actual promotion -- the seam neither side's own mocked tests exercised before this fix
behaviors.evidence: shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_promote_required_layers.py::test_end_to_end_seam_between_the_real_resolver_and_plan_promotions PASSED -- verified RED against the pre-fix lookup before being confirmed GREEN

behaviors.behavior: round-4 post-push code-reviewer fix (medium): a malformed top-level artifact requirements field (e.g. a list, from a corrupted/adversarial upload) resolves a clean error, never an uncaught AttributeError deep inside structural_diff
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_ci_execution_evidence.py::test_error_when_top_level_requirements_is_not_an_object PASSED -- verified RED (real AttributeError traceback reproduced) against the pre-fix guard ordering before being confirmed GREEN

behaviors.behavior: round-5 post-push doubt-review fix (HIGH): evidence_fingerprint hashes DERIVED facts (highest_ok_layer, bound_but_absent_layers) instead of raw coverage/tests -- the two writers' bases (committed-manifest node vs. CI-sourced eval_node) now agree whenever the FR's actual promotability-relevant state agrees, so an operator's demoted veto stays a clean skip across raw OS/marker-selection noise but genuinely re-escalates when the derived facts actually move
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_layer_promotion_ledger.py::test_evidence_fingerprint_agrees_across_raw_content_that_differs_but_derives_the_same_facts, ::test_evidence_fingerprint_disagrees_when_a_bound_test_actually_goes_absent, shared/scripts/tools/tests/test_promote_required_layers.py::test_demoted_fr_with_raw_evidence_noise_but_same_derived_facts_stays_a_clean_skip (composed through the REAL seam, both writers) ALL PASSED -- verified RED against the pre-fix raw-hash fingerprint before being confirmed GREEN

behaviors.behavior: round-5 post-push doubt-review fix (medium): a downloaded artifact's source_commit that is the zero-SHA producer-degradation sentinel, or does not look like a real 40-char hex SHA at all, resolves unavailable (not a hard error) -- distinct from a well-formed but genuinely mismatched source_commit, which still errors
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_ci_execution_evidence.py::test_unavailable_when_source_commit_is_the_zero_sha_producer_degradation, ::test_unavailable_when_source_commit_does_not_look_like_a_hex_sha_at_all, ::test_a_genuinely_mismatched_but_well_formed_source_commit_still_errors ALL PASSED -- both unavailable cases verified RED (returned error pre-fix) before being confirmed GREEN; the zero-SHA case caught a real defect in the first draft of the fix (all-zeros is valid-looking hex, so a format-only check alone did not catch it)

behaviors.behavior: round-5 post-push doubt-review fix (low): resolve_execution_evidence lowercases the caller-supplied commit before comparing it against source_commit, matching resolve_ci_verification's own normalization
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_ci_execution_evidence.py::test_resolve_execution_evidence_lowercases_the_caller_supplied_commit PASSED -- verified RED (upper-case caller commit spuriously mismatched) before being confirmed GREEN

behaviors.behavior: round-5 post-push doubt-review fix (low): an active committed-manifest node with no id (or a non-string one) is excluded from evaluation rather than escaping as a raw KeyError traceback; the other, well-formed FR in the same run is unaffected
